text: Developing a mobile app is an exciting process, but it requires careful planning. One of the first decisions is choosing between native apps, built for a single platform like iOS or Android, and cross-platform apps, which run on both using one codebase. Native apps often perform better, while cross-platform saves time and money. Once built, your app must have a responsive design, meaning it adapts smoothly to different screen sizes and orientations. Finally, you'll need to submit your app to app stores like Google Play or the Apple App Store. These platforms have strict guidelines, and your app's performance, such as how fast it loads and how little battery it uses, will be closely evaluated.
